title: Jovial Smoky Slovakian Turkey Mince Kebabs
description: Spicy, silky, midnight-craving Slovakian dish featuring turkey mince, tandoor. Great for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat your tandoor or grill to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, combine turkey mince, onion, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 kebabs, about 1 1/2 inches (3.8 cm) in length.
Thread 2-3 kebabs onto skewers, leaving a little space between each kebab. Brush the tandoor or grill with olive oil.
Place the kebabs in the preheated tandoor or grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
While the kebabs are cooking, toast the tandoor seasoning in a small dry pan over medium heat for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Remove the kebabs from the tandoor or grill and brush with toasted tandoor seasoning. Serve immediately, garnished with parsley.
